labels.text_english: WFC; WORLD CUP; ALGERIA: A COLLECTIVE FAILURE; WINAMAX; -18; GAMBLING AND GAMES OF CHANCE CAN BE DANGEROUS: LOSS OF MONEY, FAMILY CONFLICTS, ADDICTION… FIND OUR ADVICE AT JOUEURS-INFO-SERVICE.FR (09 74 75 13 13 - NON-PREMIUM CALL); GOVERNMENT; Liberty Equality Fraternity; 9:41; Installing... Speech: Tonight it's a collective failure. The players are overwhelmed, and this isn't something new we're discovering against Argentina. We already raised it during the Africa Cup of Nations. Despite reaching the quarter-final, Algeria without the ball is a very naive team. As long as you're a naive team without the ball, you'll get nowhere at the World Cup. When you say Riyad Mahrez starts on the bench, fine by me. At some point we set the player perspective aside, and I'd like us to think collective, team perspective. And that's the problem on Algeria's side. You can line up whatever individual talents you want and do 'playerism'. Tonight it's a collective failure, where without the ball you were blown apart everywhere. But is it a collective failure because some players didn't deliver? No, for me it's all of it. The plan was faulty.

He reminds me of a singer who had an incredible hit and is asked to sing the same song for 20 years. His World Cup photo album since 2014 is frightening. We are talking about a goalkeeper on 9 straight World Cup matches without a clean sheet. Neuer's last clean sheet was 13 July 2014, the final against Argentina. I don't feel we have a goalkeeper playing his destiny at this World Cup. In two matches, round of 16, potentially Germany-France. It could be a massacre. I tell you, it could be a massacre if he plays at this level.

Government. Under-18 prohibited. Speech: It's going to be hot. Wednesday 9pm, Real Madrid-Manchester City, maybe the final blow for Casablanca. My Real team is close to the cliff edge with a second trophyless season gradually taking shape. Real keep losing in La Liga. Arbeloa is already questioned by the board and by the players. In short, nothing is going right at this club. Even our talisman, Rodrygo, who has historically always scored against Manchester City, is injured for the whole year. Bellingham is absent. Same for Kylian Mbappé, bad luck to the end. Facing Real is Guardiola, since Real is doing the tour of the great coaches this year after beating José Mourinho. It's not City's best side, but it's probably Pep Guardiola's last season with the Citizens and he'll want to leave on a high. Besides, City already beat us this season at the Bernabéu, and that was already without Mbappé. So my prediction: I don't see this Real winning at home, and I'd go further: I see Manchester City winning by 2 goals to push Real into an endless crisis. And I remind you that with Unibet, you get up to 100 euros of bonus bet refunded if your first bet loses.

visible_text_verbatim: AFRIQUE DU SUD : UN MATCH DE PITRES
LES JEUX D'ARGENT ET DE HASARD PEUVENT ÊTRE DANGEREUX : PERTES D'ARGENT, CONFLITS FAMILIAUX, ADDICTION… RETROUVEZ NOS CONSEILS SUR JOUEURS-INFO-SERVICE.FR (09 74 75 13 13 - APPEL NON SURTAXÉ)
labels.text_english: World Cup. South Africa: a clown show of a match. WINAMAX. Gambling can be dangerous: loss of money, family conflicts, addiction… Find our advice at joueurs-info-service.fr (09 74 75 13 13 - toll-free call). Government: Liberty, Equality, Fraternity. Under-18 prohibited. Installing... Join the community. Speech: I'm very disappointed with the South Africa match, which I saw winning against Mexico. You have to be ruthless, you have to be unstoppable. It's a clown show tonight. It looked much more like a Springboks match than Bafana Bafana. And me, I want to tell you, it's a stake, notably the 48-team World Cup and the expansion that benefits African football. Tonight South Africa is a very bad ambassador for African football. Because I can't excuse the technical quality, which was dismal. You were overwhelmed by the opposing pressure. You were overwhelmed by events. It's a failed match from start to finish. It's a clown show on South Africa's side. And that pisses me off. It pisses me off because it's a big outsider of African football.

labels.text_english: Speech and captions: the Africa Cup of Nations is back on 21 December in Morocco. It is very hard to win: since 2010 there have been 8 winners, 7 of them different. Teams such as Egypt, Ivory Coast, Cameroon, Morocco, Senegal, DR Congo, Algeria, Nigeria and Tunisia are at a very close level. Surprises are possible, as with South Africa at the last AFCON, or Angola, Gabon, Cape Verde and Mali. The speaker hopes to relive the Ivory Coast edition and picks Morocco, at home, to win after many years of waiting. Anyone can beat anyone. On-screen warning: 'Gambling and games of chance can be dangerous: loss of money, family conflicts, addiction... Find our advice on joueurs-info-service.fr (09 74 75 13 13 - non-premium-rate call)'. Age mark: -18. Captions: 'and it returns on 21 December', 'really at a very close level', 'at the last AFCON', 'we hope to relive the same thing', 'and that's what makes'.
